title: TUEL Blueprint Manifest
description: Manifest contract for a TUEL Blueprint Standard 1.0 working folder. Claude does not read this file as instructions. tools/lint.py also enforces file-level, safety, drift, and package rules that JSON Schema cannot express.

slug.description: Lowercase identifier. Must match the blueprint directory. The _blank placeholder is accepted only for templates/_blank by tools/lint.py.

version.description: Blueprint semantic version. Approval, authority, safety, retention, protected-path, or memory-layout changes require a major version.

standard_version.description: TUEL Blueprint Standard implemented by this package.

policy_version.description: Version of the exact safety-floor policy copied into CLAUDE.md.

data_layout_version.description: Version of the protected owner-workspace layout.

operating_profile.description: Maximum unattended operating profile. Scheduled work is observe or local draft only.

platform_claims_checked_on.description: Date current platform and connection claims were checked against primary documentation.

business_type.description: Plain description of the business this blueprint supports.

summary.description: One catalog sentence an owner can understand.

skills.description: Each entry has a matching skills/<slug>/SKILL.md. review-the-work is required by tools/lint.py.

schedules.description: Each entry has a matching schedules/<slug>.md. weekly-operations-review is required by tools/lint.py.

workflows.description: Each entry has a matching workflows/<slug>.md. Standard-owned core workflows are required by tools/lint.py.

templates.description: Each entry has a matching templates/<slug>.md. Standard-owned operational record templates are required by tools/lint.py.

memory_files.description: Owner-approved business-memory stubs in business/. Source packages contain no real or invented business data.

roles.description: Ordinary Markdown role guides in roles/. These register nothing and grant no access.

protected_paths.description: Owner-workspace paths that an upgrade never overwrites or deletes. tools/lint.py requires the exact five-path set.

name.description: Tool the owner may choose to connect.

status.description: Evidence label. A recommendation does not claim installation, authorization, or compliance.

access.description: Actual capability last verified for the tool, separate from blueprint policy.

use_policy.description: Stricter behavior the blueprint permits even when the tool has broader capability.

fallback.description: Specific export, paste, or file path that works with no connection.

verified_on.description: Date the connection claim was checked.

official_url.description: Primary official source. Required by tools/lint.py for confirmed official examples.

connectors.description: Optional recommendations with evidence, actual capability, a stricter use policy, and a no-connection fallback.
